gloss: all at once; simultaneously; in unison

definitions.gloss: all at once; simultaneously; in unison
definitions.explanation: Describes multiple people or things acting at the same time in a coordinated or synchronized manner.

examples.japanese: {生徒|せいと}たちが{一斉|いっせい}に{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The students all stood up at once.

examples.japanese: {合図|あいず}とともに{一斉|いっせい}にスタートした。
examples.english: They all started simultaneously at the signal.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}の{花|はな}が{一斉|いっせい}に{咲|さ}き{始|はじ}めると、{公園|こうえん}は{大勢|おおぜい}の{花見客|はなみきゃく}でにぎわう。
examples.english: When the cherry blossoms all start blooming at once, the park bustles with crowds of flower-viewing visitors.

notes:
USAGE:
{一斉|いっせい}に emphasizes that an action happens simultaneously across a group. The noun form {一斉|いっせい} can also be used as a prefix: {一斉|いっせい}{検査|けんさ} (simultaneous inspection), {一斉|いっせい}{送信|そうしん} (mass sending/broadcast).
Compared to {同時|どうじ}に, which simply means "at the same time," {一斉|いっせい}に implies a larger group acting together and often carries a more dramatic or striking impression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一斉|いっせい}に{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる (to stand up all at once)
- {一斉|いっせい}に{始|はじ}まる (to begin simultaneously)
- {一斉|いっせい}に{咲|さ}く (to bloom all at once)
- {一斉|いっせい}{検挙|けんきょ} (mass arrest)
